limits: A source or fixture pass does not prove the installed Mac app or a TestFlight download works.
Real provider authentication and actual Codex/Claude/Hermes/agy responses need separate account-level checks.
Personal internet relay, cellular handover, camera QR scan and 30-day expiry are not end-to-end verified by these fixture checks.
Performance measures the isolated mobile initial page, not signed-in project workload or AI latency.
The simulator's optional personal HTTPS test can be skipped when no personal origin is supplied; inspect native UI evidence.

AgentsToZ Screen's Swift core and status-file checks (`bun run test:screen-control`) run inside the ios-core check, since the iOS app links that package; the Mac app's capture, lock notifications and Face ID need a real Mac and iPhone (mobile/ios/DEVICE-CHECKLIST.md).

AgentsToZ Control's Swift core checks (`bun scripts/check-computer-use-control.ts`) run inside native-workflow-foundations; the signed Control app, both XPC peer requirements, its LaunchAgent registration, the Accessibility permission and Secure Enclave approval need a signed build on a real Mac (native/computer-use/CONTRACT.md section 12).
